entityDescription:
IngeniArs was founded in 2014 as innovative start-up and University of Pisa spin-off company, from the long experience of our co-founders in the area of Electronics and Computer Science Engineering advanced research. We are specialized in design and development of innovative high-tech electronic/informatics and embedded systems mainly in the domains of Aerospace, Artificial Intelligence, Healthcare and Cybersecurity.

In the Aerospace field, we offer products and design services both for satellite design and ground testing mainly related to data handling, high-speed data interfaces (i.e., SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, Wizardlink, etc.) and satellite communication (i.e., CCSDS 131.2-B, etc.). Our products portfolio includes:
- Intellectual properties macrocells (IP Core) for the realization of high-speed reliable communication link (SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, CCSDS 131.2-B) on board of satellites, implementable on ASIC and FPGA technologies.
- Test-equipment/software in order to simplify systems verification during the development phase. Our flagship product family is SPACEART (SpaceWire/SpaceFibre Analyser Real Time) which are standalone devices for the functional verification of the high-speed links on-board of satellite (i.e., SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, Wizardlink).
- Design services: FPGA and ASIC design following customer specifications.
- Verification Services: Advanced independent verification and Verification IPs using SystemVerilog and UVM.

We are particularly active in the aerospace business providing design services in several space missions funded by the European and Italian Space Agency such as Meteosat Third Generation, Copernicus Sentinel 3, FLEX, PLATO, EUCLID, PLATINO and PHISAT-1. We are also official Microchip Design Partner and Xilinx Certified Partner with our solutions available on their websites.

For Artificial Intelligence, IngeniArs works on the development of AI algorithms, based on neural networks, with reduced complexity, so that they can be portable on devices with limited resources or implemented within hardware accelerators, e.g. an FPGA or a VPU. IngeniArs has successfully flown a cloud detection neural network on-board satellite within the ESA mission Phisat-1.

entityDescription:
Coactum aims to revolutionize cargo transportation in space - just like UPS “last mile” delivery services.
Briefly, we propose a simple, secure and fast service of in-space transportation by using standalone small satellites - simplifying access to high Earth orbits and beyond. We envision a future where moving around in space becomes as common as doing it on Earth. This is a future where our space “taxies” are safe, agile, low-cost, and often thrilling – able to move cargo, and eventually people, to multiple outposts. By applying our proprietary high-thrust hybrid propulsion technologies, Coactum aims to radically increase the safety and reduce the cost of in-space transportation, allowing fast access to orbits which are otherwise expensive to reach.
We are developing a platform in-house to bring instruments and deploy nanosatellites at their desired orbits: a space delivery vehicle. Both the propulsion system and the satellite platform are scalable, allowing us to quickly and effectively adapt them tootential markets for future stages of the project. Among them:launchers upper stages, landers and ascent vehicles,crafts tolunar and Martian outposts, de-orbiting devices, human transportation, or space clean-up crews.

description: Nitrexo is an engineering company specialized in delivering cost-effective solutions for thermal, mechanical, and analytical problems in the space industry. We have achieved expertise in space thermal and mechanical engineering through the successful delivery of various projects such as PROBA, MTG, EUCLID, ExoMars, Luna 27 and MetOp-SG across Europe. entityDescription:
Nitrexo’s Expertise

Thermal and mechanical engineering, particularly in the space industry, is the expertise of Nitrexo, a start-up company based in Ireland. The team has 20 years experience in Thermal and Mechanical Engineering &
Space and Technology. The company provides engineering and consultancy services, as well as digital solutions, and various space products, to its clients.

Nitrexo’s competence involves using ESATAN-TMS for conducting thermal analyses on space systems and sub-systems prior to the implementation of the thermal design. This ensures that the device or product that undergoes analysis and testing will function effectively under certain space conditions. 

In addition, the company specializes in thermal hardware (MLI, radiators, heat pipes, heaters and thermal straps), payloads, platforms, system level, struts, solar panels, mechanisms, instruments, antennas, sensors, mirrors, electronics, cameras, optoelectronics devices for satellites, rockets, microelectronic components, and mechanical ground support equipment. Clients are also assured of receiving a technical reports on their projects.

Having completed projects for the ESA and QinetiQ, Nitrexo’s strengths include running tests and verifications, as well as the integration of improvements to various engineering designs and processes.

Nitrexo’s Mission and Vision

Nitrexo believes in democratic ways of doing things to achieve competence and expertise, particularly in the field of space thermal and mechanical engineering. In this regard, it uses education as an effective platform and tool for enhancing people’s capabilities.

Through its digital solutions, it aims to provide any interested party--whether business entities or individuals--equal access to educational and skills enhancement materials and applications that will help them create and innovate effectively.

Knowledge Management

Nitrexo guarantees that its training programs are not limited only to the transfer of theoretical knowledge to thermal engineers but that they also teach them how to accurately apply such knowledge in their field of work. Thus, Nitrexo trainings are designed to ensure a delightful user experience.

entityDescription: GeoVille is an internationally operating company providing consultancy, services and products related to remote sensing, geo-information and geographic information systems. The University is actively involved in fundamental and applied research, technology development, and knowledge transfer, collaborating with national and international public institutions, research centres, and industry.
The University of Valladolid has extensive experience in the management and participation in competitive research projects funded by national and international programmes, including European and international initiatives. Its research activities are supported by dedicated administrative and management units responsible for research funding, project administration, and compliance with legal and financial requirements.
UVa’s mission includes the generation, dissemination, and transfer of knowledge, contributing to scientific, technological, economic, and social development at regional, national, and international levels.
